[[Ecruteak City]] }} '''Piloswine Whine''' (Japanese: '''VS イノムー''' ''VS {{tt|Inomoo|Piloswine}}''), titled '''VS Piloswine''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 110th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 20th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Outside the [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]], [[Sham]], [[Carl]], and {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s appear. The Team Rocket Grunts send out {{p|Cubone}}, {{p|Drowzee}}, {{p|Ledian}}, and a {{p|Ninetales}} to attack {{adv|Gold}} and [[Polibo]]. {{adv|Silver}} tells Gold that [[Team Rocket]] caused the earthquake. Carl then recognizes Silver, and tells the Grunts to attack Silver too, but the Pokémon that try are knocked out by Gold and [[Exbo]]. Carl's {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Piloswine}} appears, and attacks Gold and Silver. When Gold tells Polibo to use {{m|Water Gun}}, Polibo does nothing. Silver lets Gold battle the Team Rocket Grunts, while he battles the Piloswine. Piloswine chases Silver, who is {{m|Fly}}ing on his {{TP|Silver|Murkrow}} to dodge. However, with the power of {{wp|liquefaction}} and Polibo's {{m|Whirlpool}}, Piloswine is defeated. Then Carl notices that Gold has defeated the Team Rocket Grunts' Pokémon. Sham then says that their mission is complete, so they can retreat. After Team Rocket retreats, Gold and Silver [[trade]] again. Then, Gold challenges Silver to a battle. Meanwhile at the evacuation shelter, some doctors are taking care of [[Jasmine]]. She tells them about Gold and Silver rescuing her, but they do not believe her. Elsewhere, in [[Ecruteak City]] and Gold and Silver get ready to battle. ==Major events== * {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Silver}} fight against [[Carl]] and {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s. * Silver [[trade]]s [[Polibo]] back to Gold. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Piloswine}} * {{p|Ledian}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * [[Jasmine]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]] (flashback) * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]] (flashback) * [[Sham]] * [[Carl]] * {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Aipom}} ([[Aibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Politoed}} ([[Polibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Quilava}} ([[Exbo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Sunkern}} (Sunbo; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Togepi}} ([[Togebo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Murkrow}} ({{OP|Silver|Murkrow}}) * {{p|Totodile}} ({{OP|Silver|Totodile}}; flashback) * {{p|Ursaring}} ({{OP|Silver|Ursaring}}; flashback) * {{p|Ampharos}} ([[Amphy]]; [[Jasmine]]'s) * {{p|Piloswine}} ([[Carl]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Cubone}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s's; multiple) * {{p|Ninetales}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s's) * {{p|Drowzee}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s's; multiple) * {{p|Ledian}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s's; multiple) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * [[Carl]] says that {{adv|Silver}} foiled [[Team Rocket]]'s plans back at [[New Bark Town]]'s [[Slowpoke Well]]. However, the Slowpoke Well is located in [[Azalea Town]], not New Bark Town. * While running from {{p|Piloswine}}, {{adv|Silver}} said that Piloswine was the only Pokémon that possesses both {{t|Water}} and {{t|Ice}} attacks. However, this is not true, since many Pokémon from [[Generation I]] could use both Water- and Ice-type moves. What he probably meant was that Piloswine was the only Pokémon that could use both Ice- and Ground-type moves. ** Both of these errors were fixed in the digital volume release by VIZ Media as well as in the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese}} translation. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 長毛豬|VS Piloswine}} (Taiwan)
